chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: Coleman Hawkins and the guest bands at the Cotton Club
summary: The Howards recall Hawkins, Armstrong and Don Redman playing the Cotton Club while Howard's band did intermissions; Howard says he worked with Hawkins around 1926-27.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

Yeah.
Not at that period?
Not at that period, but he played with another outfit there, down at -- down on --
